notes.title: v1.1.0 Colorful Creation Update | Changes | Features | Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hi,

The first major update, the Colorful Creation update has finally arrived! One of the things that I had planned for this update was to include spawning animations, but there had already been so many changes that I decided to leave it for another time. Instead of spawning animations, I've finally included a way to edit any of your creations. I hope this makes things much easier for you.

As part of this update I added three new pets. The Axolotl Larvae, Hedgehog Hoglet, and Otter Kit.
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44739450/87b0872d9e1b55a6c13adbe3db0c6aede7e6ff22.png[/img]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44739450/a6569c6fb3ed13925b02c3b11edadb6553ca00a8.png[/img]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44739450/0467a5e3a830259f691e98d21460a0699fb17896.png[/img]

But the pets weren't the only major change. The other largest change is that you can now have any color pet that you want. This doesn't only apply to the pets already included, even your creations and Steam Workshop mods can be colored as well!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44739450/d738af10d03a77de4354991901352fb293e462f2.png[/img]

I won't be changing things for a while, but as always I'll be on the lookout for any bugs or issues. 

Talk to you soon and take care.

Developer, David Cardenas

[h1]Changelog - 1.1.0[/h1]
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Optimized GPU performance
[*] Highlight tab when hovered over
[*] Increased border highlight thickness when hovering over icons in Spawn Tab
[*] Split Spawn Tab into Original, Created, and Workshop categories
[*] Workshop items can now be unsubscribed to using the menu
[*] A more advanced Create tab
[*] More useful messages for invalid inputs in Create tab
[*] "Loops" has replaced "Seconds" for animations
[*] Workshop Uploader tab clears itself upon successful upload
[*] When editing a mod, tags and item description are now filled it automatically
[/list]
[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added Axolotl Larvae, Hedgehog Hoglet, and Otter Kit
[*] Can now color a virtual pet, companion, or other digital friend any color
[*] A "Weight" can now be applied to animations
[*] A scale for all sprite sheets can now be applied
[*] Added menu intro animation with tray hint
[*] Added editor for items made in Create tab
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed Workshop tab switching back to list of Workshop mods from a different screen. This would occurs after list has finished loading in
[*] Fixed if subscribed and you spawn a subscribed item and then unsubscribe through the browser, program will crash. You now get a message notifying you of the missing spawn
[*] Fixed where the last frame of a landing animation was not being shown
[/list]

notes.title: Upcoming 1.1.0 Update | Save Files | Created Pets
notes.content:
Hi.

I'm nearing the completion of the 1.1.0 update. This is a notice that since there were such large scale changes any current save files will have to be wiped and any pets made through the Create tab will have to be remade again.

This upcoming update should have a little bit for everyone, such as new pets, a better menu, and more options when creating your animations. There were a lot more changes but these other changes will be listed once the update has gone out.

Talk to you soon and take care.

Developer, David Cardenas

notes.title: Upcoming 1.1.0 Update | Bugs | Sneak Peek
notes.content:
Hi,

I'm well aware of some of the recent bugs that have been found. Some are small, while others are more serious. I'll be including a fix for all of these in the upcoming 1.1.0 update. Many of the tabs will also be reworked, so you can hopefully have a much more fluid experience when using the menu.

If you're curious here's a sneak peek into one of the additions I decided to include.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44739450/82a1cf991b14a93c1201a0489440774f803338a6.png[/img]

I'm well underway at reworking large portions of the app and I'm making good progress. I'm actually really interested in seeing what kinds of animations will be made.

If you have any suggestions, questions, or have encountered any new bugs, always feel free to use the general discussions forum and I'll continuously stop by to read all messages.

Thank you for all of those that have purchased the app so far and I hope the upcoming update makes everything more fun, interesting, and easier for you.

A new year is coming up, so Happy New Year! Talk to you soon and take care.

Developer, David Cardenas

notes.title: v1.0.0 Release | Future Updates
notes.content:
Hello,

I hope you're all doing well, I know the holidays can be a bit hectic sometimes. Today is the day that v1.0.0 of Anemis can now be downloaded. If you have any suggestions or you have any issues, always feel free to use the steam discussions forum, and I'll continually check up on it.

Now to talk about the future. One of the first updates that I will implement will be the addition of the Steam Workshop, so that you can more easily share any creations you've made. Imagine having your favorites characters animated on your desktop. There are other larger updates that I've already planned and will implement after I've finished the Steam Workshop integration. I'll speak more about these larger updates in the future. 

Talk to you soon, and take care.

Developer, David Cardenas

notes.title: Upcoming Changes And More Kittens And Puppies
notes.content:
Hello,

Originally, I planned to start with just one kitten and one puppy. However, I wanted more than just these two, so I will be replacing the initial kitten and puppy with five unique kittens and five unique puppies. Please note that this change will also affect all screenshots, and the trailer will be updated accordingly.

I'll discuss any future plans upon the full release on December 15. Talk to you soon, and take care.

Developer David Cardenas
